text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало has been feeling tired, so I
take her to
the infirmary and have her
rest.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's not like this level of effort is enough
to wear
me out, but I suppose I'll take
your advice this
time...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: What... Where am I?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Oh, my liege! At long last, you've
awakened!
text_block_list.name: Bob-cut Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
...That's right! I am the magnificent King,
the
rightful ruler of all the land!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Verily! My liege shall reign over all the
lands of
Tracen as its first true king!
text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Hear, hear! Let us henceforth declare
the
founding of our new kingdom!
text_block_list.name: Bob-cut Umamusume

text_block_list.text: As if I need to be told. Now, listen well!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I, King, hereby declare the
establishment of the
kingly kingdom of
King Kingdom!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Come pay obeisance to your king!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: King! ♪ King! ♪ King Kingdom! ♪
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Followers

text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Marvelous!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
My first decree is for the construction of
one
hundred fashion boutiques
exclusively for my
royal patronage!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: ...Eh? Oh, I'm back...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hm... My body is light, and I feel less
tired...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Why, I feel completely refreshed! I want
to run
right now!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Hehe, it's time to get back to training!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I bear ill tidings! The neighboring Seiun
Kingdom's
army has breached our
borders!
text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Bah, those fools... I'll smash them to bits.
Ready
the troops for battle!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
But, my liege, the three of us cannot
hope to
stand against an invading army
of one hundred
thousand!
text_block_list.name: Bob-cut Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
You mean to say it's only us three?! How
can we
even call this a country?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
What shall we do, my liege? Perhaps the
enemy
will show us lenience if you
apologize.
text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume

text_block_list.text:
Out of the question! Just imagining Sky's

triumphant smile twists my stomach up in
knots!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Wait, they're already here?! If things
continue like
th-this...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: King Kingdom will fall!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... What—where am I?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Oh... I had the most horrible dream...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the nightmare, Кинг Хало
wakes up still
tired.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The rejuvenated Кинг Хало leaves the
infirmary in
high spirits.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
